# 4News

4News is a minimal, objective, AI-powered Australian news briefing site at https://4news.com.au/.

The site rewrites and summarises public-source Australian news into concise multi-source briefs. Its three main user benefits are simple English learning, finding conversation topics, and quickly understanding Australia. It prioritises social issues and development issues that affect everyday life, public policy, infrastructure, technology, energy, services, communities, and Australia's long-term direction. It links to original sources for verification and may include source-difference notes, public social discussion links, public-figure context, and optional 4News commentary. 4News is a briefing layer and does not claim first-party reporting.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://4news.com.au/
- Crawlable brief index: https://4news.com.au/briefs/
- About: https://4news.com.au/about.html

- Corrections: https://4news.com.au/corrections.html
- Privacy: https://4news.com.au/privacy.html

## Machine-readable news data

- English: https://4news.com.au/news.en.json
- Simplified Chinese: https://4news.com.au/news.zh-Hans.json
- Traditional Chinese: https://4news.com.au/news.zh-Hant.json
- Sinhala: https://4news.com.au/news.si.json
- Japanese: https://4news.com.au/news.ja.json
- Korean: https://4news.com.au/news.ko.json
- Vietnamese: https://4news.com.au/news.vi.json
- Thai: https://4news.com.au/news.th.json

## Content principles

- Support multilingual readers who want simple English exposure, useful social conversation topics, and fast context about Australia.
- Prioritise social issues, development issues, public policy, governance, infrastructure, energy, technology, labour, housing, health, education, community safety, and long-term national capacity.
- Sports, entertainment, celebrity, crime, and disaster items should be treated as priority only when they reveal broader social, institutional, safety, or development implications.
- 4News does not copy full news articles, images, video, audio, or publisher logos.
- Original source links should be used for full context.
- AI-generated briefs may contain errors and should be checked against original sources.
- Public-figure context is limited to news-relevant public figures. Private individuals, victims, minors, and ordinary witnesses should not be amplified.
